name: LED'oh!
description: Graphical LED color controller with per-LED animations for NextUI on TrimUI Brick and Smart Pro.
author: Eric Reinsmidt

changelog.v0.5.0: Dynamic animation discovery — drop .sh scripts in the scripts folder and they appear in the menu automatically. Added Lava Lamp animation. User-created animation support with NAME header convention.
changelog.v0.4.0: 15 per-LED animations via frame_hex (Brick only). Animations persist across app exit and reboot. Settings backup/restore preserves colors while animations run. Simplified state model (removed toggle, removed save prompt). Blip-free animation handoff.
changelog.v0.2.0: Smart Pro support (3 zones: joystick rings, logo triangle). LED toggle (∴ button). Random front image variants. Pill-shaped selection borders on FN keys. Brightness sharing notes in zone settings. Smart Pro GRB color fix for logo LED. Joystick leak fix in color picker. Preserves color2/trigger/inbrightness from settings file.
changelog.v0.1.0: Initial release. Front/back device view with LED zone overlays, 2D HSL color picker with live LED preview, per-zone brightness/effect/speed settings, NextUI-compatible settings file.
